title: Sunday Services
description: Experience the prophetic word, dynamic worship, and the undeniable presence of God to start your week with power. Two services back-to-back.

title: Moment of Grace
description: A morning devoted to teaching, worship, and prayer — come and encounter the grace of God to start your week strong.

title: Midweek Service
description: Dive deep into the scriptures and uncover the mysteries of the Kingdom to build a solid foundation of faith.

title: Breakthrough Service
description: A special evening service held every third Sunday, contending in prayer and prophetic declaration for breakthrough in every area of life.

title: Spiritual Week of Empowerment
description: Three consecutive nights of empowerment — held the first Monday through Wednesday of every month — to build up believers in the Word and in the Spirit.

title: Annual Faith Conference
description: A multi-day gathering of believers to be equipped, imparted, and sent forth. Prepare for a mighty move of the Spirit.

title: Youth Summit
description: Empowering the next generation to lead with faith and conviction. Workshops, intense worship, and prophetic impartation.
